# Design the Training Plan {#design-training-plan}

Before opening Unity, use the interactive planner below to prepare the structure and content of your training.

You can use the planner to:

- Identify the training format
- Add scenes and videos
- Add questions to each scene
- Write instructions and feedback
- Identify when instructions and questions will appear
- Save your progress in the browser
- Print the completed training plan or save it as a PDF

> **Note:** Your progress is saved only in the current browser and device.

---

## Training Information {-}

```{=html}
<div class="simple-planner">

<label>
<strong>Training title</strong>
<input type="text" placeholder="Enter the training title">
</label>

<label>
<strong>Training objective</strong>
<textarea rows="3" placeholder="Describe what participants should learn."></textarea>
</label>

<label>
<strong>Video format</strong>
<select>
  <option>Continuous video with embedded questions</option>
  <option>Branching video with different outcomes</option>
</select>
</label>

<label>
<strong>Number of scenes or videos</strong>
<input type="number" min="1" placeholder="Enter the number of scenes">
</label>

<h3>General Preparation Checklist</h3>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
The training objective has been identified.
</label>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
The video format has been selected.
</label>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
All videos have been recorded or prepared.
</label>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
The questions and answer choices have been written.
</label>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
Correct and corrective feedback has been prepared.
</label>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
The appearance times for instructions and questions have been identified.
</label>

<hr>

<h3>Scene 1</h3>

<label>
<strong>Scene or video name</strong>
<input type="text" placeholder="Enter the scene name">
</label>

<label>
<strong>Video filename</strong>
<input type="text" placeholder="Example: scene-01.mp4">
</label>

<label>
<strong>Video duration</strong>
<input type="text" placeholder="Example: 06:30">
</label>

<label>
<strong>Scene objective</strong>
<textarea rows="2" placeholder="Describe the purpose of this scene."></textarea>
</label>

<h4>Question 1</h4>

<label>
<strong>Instruction appearance time</strong>
<input type="text" placeholder="Example: 02:00">
</label>

<label>
<strong>Question appearance time</strong>
<input type="text" placeholder="Example: 03:00">
</label>

<label>
<strong>Instruction text</strong>
<textarea rows="2" placeholder="Write the instruction shown before the question."></textarea>
</label>

<label>
<strong>Question text</strong>
<textarea rows="2" placeholder="Write the question."></textarea>
</label>

<label>
<strong>Answer choice 1</strong>
<input type="text" placeholder="Enter the first answer">
</label>

<label>
<strong>Answer choice 2</strong>
<input type="text" placeholder="Enter the second answer">
</label>

<label>
<strong>Answer choice 3</strong>
<input type="text" placeholder="Optional">
</label>

<label>
<strong>Answer choice 4</strong>
<input type="text" placeholder="Optional">
</label>

<label>
<strong>Correct answer</strong>
<select>
  <option>Answer choice 1</option>
  <option>Answer choice 2</option>
  <option>Answer choice 3</option>
  <option>Answer choice 4</option>
</select>
</label>

<label>
<strong>Correct-answer feedback</strong>
<textarea rows="2" placeholder="Explain why the answer is correct."></textarea>
</label>

<label>
<strong>Corrective feedback</strong>
<textarea rows="2" placeholder="Explain why the selected answer is incorrect."></textarea>
</label>

<h4>Question Checklist</h4>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
The instruction is short and clear.
</label>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
The question is directly related to the video.
</label>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
The correct answer has been designated.
</label>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
Correct and corrective feedback has been written.
</label>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
The instruction and question times have been verified.
</label>

<hr>

<h3>Final Checklist</h3>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
All scene names have been finalized.
</label>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
All video filenames and durations have been recorded.
</label>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
All questions have the required answer choices.
</label>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
All pause times occur in the correct order.
</label>

<label class="check-item">
<input type="checkbox">
The complete training plan has been reviewed.
</label>

<p class="print-instruction">
<strong>To print this checklist:</strong> press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>P</kbd>
and select your printer or <strong>Save as PDF</strong>.
</p>

</div>
```
